input.quote: 10.4 Covenants of AbbVie. AbbVie covenants to Harpoon as follows:
input.rationale:
Searches for "solicit", "induce", "hire" and "employ" across the Agreement return no employee non-solicitation, no-hire or anti-poaching covenant. AbbVie's only affirmative covenant (Section 10.4.1) concerns obtaining IP/confidentiality rights from its personnel, and the miscellaneous article (Section 13) contains only force majeure and Harpoon change-of-control provisions. The nearest employee-related restriction, Section 6.15 (No Other Compensation), merely confirms that no side payments have been made to the other Party's employees in connection with the transaction; it does not restrict hiring or solicitation. The Agreement therefore imposes no non-solicit on us, which is the playbook's preferred position, so no redline is required.</parationale>
